shapeSummary: Stepped solid of revolution along Y, with the bottom at Y=0 and a total height of 22 mm. It has a 6 mm diameter standoff from Y=0 to 8, a 10 mm diameter wheel body from Y=8 to 18 with 1 mm chamfers on both edges, and a 7 mm diameter screw head from Y=18 to 22. A 4 mm diameter, 8 mm deep blind hole is cut into the bottom face.
warnings: Total height of 22 mm is scaled from the drawing and is not printed on it.
Screw head diameter (about 7 mm) and height above the wheel (about 4 mm) are estimated from the drawing.
The 3mm hex socket in the screw head is not modeled because its depth is not given.
Threads are not modeled. The M4 bottom hole is a plain 4 mm nominal diameter blind hole.
The 13 mm base-to-center height in the listing does not match any dimension in the drawing, so it was not used.
Chamfer size of 1 mm is estimated from the 10 mm overall height versus the 8 mm flat height.
The listed kit contains several units, but only one unit is modeled.
